events.summary: You work. Gloombo works too.Come spend a little time on Gloombo’s floating island and see what you can make together.Gloombo crafts while you focus on your own tasks. When you take a break, there’s a little home to look after: decorate with the things she’s made, tend your garden, fulfill orders from distant lands, or spend some time with the cat.There’s no rush. events.title: Gloombo is in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hi everyone,Gloombo is part of Steam Next Fest this year, and the free demo is ready for anyone who wants to visit the island.If you're new here: Gloombo is a small game that lives on your desktop while you do other things. You decorate a floating island, craft things while you focus, and spend time with Gloombo and the creatures around her. It isn't built to demand your attention. events.summary: A new little friend has arrived on the island! We've also made some improvements and squashed a few bugs thanks to your feedback. Here's what's changed in Demo 0.8.2! NewMeet the Mail Bird! Whenever you receive a letter, a little bird will fly in and perch on your postbox. events.title: Gloombo is joining Companion Falls For You!
events.summary: We’re happy to share that Gloombo is part of Companion Falls For You, a Steam event celebrating desktop companion games this autumn. It feels like a particularly fitting event for us to join. Gloombo has always been about companionship in a fairly simple sense: sharing a little bit of your everyday time with something that lives beside you.
